summary: Iteration 40: Tested Finance Reconciliation Tab and Student Management features. All 18 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI verified: Reconciliation tab loads with year group selector, editable cells for Finance, approve button for Management, PDF download. Student Registry Account tab has editable email field and Delete Student button.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /finance/reconciliation returns students with correct fields (student_id, name, total_due, total_paid, balance, status)
Backend: Finance officer can access reconciliation data
Backend: CEO (management) can access reconciliation data
Backend: POST /finance/reconciliation/save persists entries with 'pending' status
Backend: POST /finance/reconciliation/approve changes status to 'approved' (CEO/SuperAdmin only)
Backend: Finance officer cannot approve (403 Forbidden)
Backend: GET /finance/reconciliation/pdf generates valid PDF with token auth
Backend: PDF works with Authorization header
Backend: Year group selector returns different data for each year
Backend: GET /admin/students/{id} returns student with email field
Backend: PUT /admin/students/{id} can update email
Backend: Email uniqueness validation rejects duplicate emails (400)
Backend: DELETE /admin/students/{id} removes student and related data
Backend: Finance officer cannot delete students (403)
Backend: Delete non-existent student returns 404
Frontend: Reconciliation tab loads with year group selector
Frontend: Finance officer sees editable Total Due and Total Paid inputs
Frontend: Download PDF button present
Frontend: Student Registry shows year group breakdown
Frontend: Student profile Account tab has Login Email input
Frontend: Delete Student Permanently button in Danger Zone
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Reconciliation PDF download was using wrong localStorage key ('token' instead of 'tcis_token')
Reconciliation endpoints properly check FINANCE_ROLES for save and MANAGEMENT_ROLES for approve
Student delete endpoint cleans up related data (invoices, payments, grades, etc.)
Email uniqueness validation in update_student prevents duplicate emails
